snippet.title: Sea of Dreams Survivors — Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Please add Sea of Dreams Survivors to your wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3484590/Sea_of_Dreams_Survivors/

Sea of Dreams Survivors is a fast-paced survival roguelike set aboard the eerie and foreboding Sea of Dreams. Trapped in The Other World—a nightmarish dimension crawling with unspeakable horrors—you must fight to survive relentless waves of monstrous foes and uncover the dark secrets of this cursed place.
